title: Summit Gold Status Award Rate Card by Payment Record, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Rate card.** The payment record of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement sets the Gold record percentage of a Summit Gold status award redeemed from its company points. The percentage follows the late fees charged on the agreement in the Gold record window: the 12 calendar months up to and including the redemption date, each late fee placed by the date it was charged on the agreement's invoice entries.

| Late fees charged on the agreement in the 12-month window | Gold record percentage |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 125 percent |
| exactly 1 | 110 percent |
| none | 100 percent (the full price) |

**How the percentage acts.** The Gold record percentage multiplies the standard Gold award price, the tier's Summit Gold status-award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

### Boundary rows

| Late fees in the window | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 0 | 100 |
| 1 | 110 |
| 2 | 125 |
| 4 | 125 |

### Example (hypothetical)

With a standard Gold award price of 3800 points and one late fee in the window, and no other percentage on the price, the price becomes 3800 multiplied by 110 and divided by one hundred, which is 4180 points.
